faqs.question: Kya main Maithili ya Bhojpuri bolne wale pandit book kar sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Haan. Booking ke time apni bhasha chuniye. Hum aapko aise pandit se milayenge jo aapke parivar ki vidhi jaante hon, lekin ye aapki date par availability par depend karta hai.

faqs.question: "With samagri" mein kya-kya shamil hai?
faqs.answer: Us puja ka poora kit: roli, akshat, kalash ka saamaan, havan samagri, ghee, kapoor, dhoop aur aisi cheezein. Taaze phal, phool aur doodh shayad aapko khud arrange karne padein; hum list confirm kar dete hain.

faqs.question: Kya pandit ji muhurat nikaalte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan. Hamein function aur apni pasand ki dates bataiye. Pandit ji panchang dekhkar aapke confirm karne se pehle time suggest karte hain.

faqs.question: Kya main extra dakshina de sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Riwaaj ke hisaab se aap extra dakshina ya daan de sakte hain. Ye aapki marzi hai, TiptoBook ki taraf se zaroori nahi hai.

faqs.question: Date badalne ka koi charge hai?
faqs.answer: Puja se 24 ghante pehle tak date badalna free hai. Peak lagan season mein date badalna pandit ki availability par depend karta hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap Gaya mein pind daan karwaate hain?
faqs.answer: Is package mein nahi. Yahan ghar par shraddh shamil hai; Gaya pind daan alag service ke roop mein list kiya jaayega.

maid-service.name: Maid Services — Mahina ya Daily
maid-service.shortDescription: Verified house help jhadu, pocha, bartan aur khana banane ke liye. Ek visit ya monthly plan book karein.

Mehmaan aane se pehle ya tyohaar ki safai ke liye one-time visit chunein, ya monthly plan lein jismein wahi helper roz fixed time par aata hai. Plans mein jhadu, pocha, dusting, bartan aate hain, aur agar aap cooking add karein to khana banana bhi. Full-day aur live-in helper bhi milte hain. Har helper ki ID pehle visit se pehle check hoti hai. Booking ke time apne ghar ka size, timing aur kaam batayein. Agar helper aapko theek na lage, to bolein, hum koi aur helper bhejne ki koshish karenge.

faqs.question: Helper ka verification kaise hota hai?
faqs.answer: Pehle visit se pehle hum government ID aur address check karte hain. Monthly aur live-in helpers ka police verification bhi hota hai.

faqs.question: Kya safai ka saaman mujhe dena hoga?
faqs.answer: Haan. Jhadu, pocha, balti, floor cleaner aur bartan ka sabun ready rakhein. Helper kuch nahi laata.

faqs.question: Helper ko kitne din ki chhutti milti hai?
faqs.answer: Monthly plans mein hafte mein ek off milta hai. Booking ke time din chun lein.

faqs.question: Kya main baad mein kaam badal sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Haan. Cooking ya zyada kamre add karne se monthly price badalta hai; naya amount lagu hone se pehle hum confirm karte hain.

faqs.question: Agar helper se khush nahi hoon to?
faqs.answer: Humein batayein. Hum doosra helper bhejne ki koshish karenge; plan ka amount aage carry ho jayega.

elder-care.name: Elder Care Services
elder-care.shortDescription: Aapke mummy-papa ke liye ghar par trained attendant ya nurse. Din, raat ya 24 ghante ki care.
elder-care.fullDescription: Patna mein bahut se parivaron mein mummy-papa ghar par hote hain aur bachche doosre shehron mein kaam karte hain. Nahane, khana khilane, chalne-phirne, toilet aur dawai yaad dilane mein madad ke liye trained attendant book kariye. Aap 12 ghante ki day shift, 12 ghante ki night shift, ya live-in attendant chun sakte hain jo poore din-raat saath rahta hai. Injection, dressing ya surgery ke baad monitoring ke liye qualified nurse (GNM/B.Sc) book kariye. Har caregiver ko bhejne se pehle hum unka ID aur police record check karte hain. Aap kuch din se shuru karke baad mein monthly plan le sakte hain. Medical faisle aapke doctor hi lenge.

faqs.question: Attendant aur nurse mein kya fark hai?
faqs.answer: Attendant roz ke kaam sambhalta hai jaise nahana, khilana aur chalana. Nurse medical kaam ke liye trained hoti hai jaise injection, IV line aur ghaav ki care.

faqs.question: Kya caregiver verified hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Pehli shift se pehle hum sarkari ID, address aur police record check karte hain.

faqs.question: Kya meri mummy ke liye female attendant mil sakti hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Booking ke time bata dijiye, hum female caregiver bhejenge.

faqs.question: Live-in attendant ko humse kya chahiye?
faqs.answer: Khana aur sone ki jagah. Din mein woh thode-thode rest break lete hain.

faqs.question: Kya hospital se discharge ke baad sirf kuch din ke liye book kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan. Daily billing available hai; monthly plan mein per din kharcha kam padta hai.

faqs.question: Agar caregiver chhutti le le to?
faqs.answer: Hum usi shift ke liye replacement bhejne ki koshish karte hain taaki care na ruke.

laundry-ironing.name: Laundry aur Ironing Service
laundry-ironing.shortDescription: Ironing, wash & fold aur dry cleaning, Patna mein aapke ghar se free pickup aur drop ke saath.
laundry-ironing.fullDescription: Apne kapde ghar ke darwaze par hi de dijiye aur saaf, press kiye hue aur pack kiye hue wapas paaiye. Aap per piece steam ironing, weight ke hisaab se wash & fold ya wash & iron, ya saree, suit, blazer aur woollen kapdon ke liye dry cleaning chun sakte hain. Pickup ke time kapdon ka weight ya ginti aapke saamne hi hoti hai, isliye hamare jaane se pehle hi aap bill dekh lete hain. Normal wash lagbhag 48 ghante mein wapas aata hai; dry cleaning mein 2–4 din lagte hain. Daag ya nazuk kapdon ke baare mein booking notes mein bata dijiye. Payment online kar sakte hain ya delivery par cash de sakte hain.

faqs.question: Wash & fold ka charge kaise lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Weight ke hisaab se. Pickup wale bhaiya aapke darwaze par kapde taulte hain aur jaane se pehle aapko amount dikha dete hain.

faqs.question: Kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Ironing ke kapde agle din wapas aa jaate hain. Wash & fold ya wash & iron mein lagbhag do din lagte hain. Dry cleaning mein do se chaar din lagte hain.

faqs.question: Kya mere kapde doosron ke kapdon ke saath dhule jaate hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Har order alag dhula jaata hai aur us par tag lagaya jaata hai taaki kuch bhi mix na ho.

faqs.question: Kya aap saare daag hata sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Jo daag aap batate hain unka treatment hum karte hain, lekin purane ya jame hue daag shayad poori tarah na niklein. Agar koi daag reh jaata hai to hum aapko bata denge.

faqs.question: Agar koi kapda kharab ho jaaye ya kho jaaye to?
faqs.answer: Delivery ke time hi bata dijiye. Compensation hamari laundry policy ke hisaab se milega.

faqs.question: Kya koi minimum order hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, free pickup aur drop ke liye wash order mein 4 kg ya ironing mein 20 piece hone chahiye.

home-cctv.name: Ghar ke liye CCTV Setup
home-cctv.shortDescription: Aapke ghar mein wired CCTV fitting, DVR, hard disk aur phone par live view ke saath.
home-cctv.fullDescription: Technician aapke ghar aakar dekhega ki camera kahan lagne chahiye, phir 2, 4 ya 8 wired camera recorder ke saath fit karega (DVR, ya IP camera ke liye NVR). Cable deewar ke saath ya pehle se lagi conduit ke andar se le jaaya jaata hai, hard disk format ki jaati hai, recording chalu ki jaati hai, aur aapke phone par brand ka app set kiya jaata hai taaki aap live dekh sakein aur purani recording (footage) chala sakein. Camera kit aap humse le sakte hain (CP Plus, Hikvision ya Dahua) ya pehle se khareede hue camera humein de sakte hain. Labour ka rate package ke hisaab se hai; hardware aur extra cable ka charge alag se lagta hai.

faqs.question: Kya main apne camera de sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Haan. Sirf labour package book kijiye. Mounting se pehle hum check karte hain ki hardware chal raha hai; kharab unit aapke seller ko hi badalna hoga.

faqs.question: Kaun sa brand lena chahiye?
faqs.answer: CP Plus, Hikvision aur Dahua Patna mein sabse common brands hain jo bikte bhi hain aur service bhi hoti hai. Teeno ke spare parts aur local repair aasani se mil jaate hain.

faqs.question: Kitne din ki recording milegi?
faqs.answer: Yeh hard disk ke size, camera ki sankhya aur resolution par depend karta hai. 1 TB disk mein 4 HD camera ki recording aam taur par lagbhag 2–3 hafte tak rehti hai; technician aapko exact figure dikha dega.

faqs.question: Kya main camera apne phone par dekh paunga?
faqs.answer: Haan, agar DVR aapke Wi-Fi router ya internet line se juda hai. Hum brand ka app install karke device aapke liye add kar dete hain.

faqs.question: Kya light jaane par bhi chalega?
faqs.answer: Apne aap nahi. DVR aur camera chalu rakhne ke liye chhota UPS ya inverter connection lagwa lijiye.

faqs.question: Kya aap hidden wiring karte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, site check ke baad. Concealed wiring ke liye wall chasing karni padti hai aur iska quote per metre diya jaata hai.

cctv-maintenance.name: CCTV Repair aur Maintenance
cctv-maintenance.shortDescription: No-video, dhundhli picture, DVR, cable ya mobile-view ki problem theek karne ke liye technician visit, saath mein yearly AMC bhi.
cctv-maintenance.fullDescription: Jab camera mein blank screen aaye, DVR recording band kar de, ya app offline ho jaye, to technician aakar fault dhundhta hai. Visit fee mein fault check (diagnosis) shamil hai. Koi bhi kaam shuru hone se pehle aap repair quote approve karte hain, aur agar aap repair karwate hain to visit fee final bill mein adjust ho jati hai. Aam taur par yeh cheezein theek hoti hain: loose connector, kharab power supply, cable fault, hard disk error aur app reconnection. Jin ghar aur dukaan mein zyada camera hain, unke liye yearly maintenance plan (AMC) hai jismein tay samay par cleaning, health check aur priority visit milte hain. Spare parts printed price par charge hote hain.
bullets: Camera, DVR/NVR, hard disk, power supply aur cable ka fault check
Kaam se pehle repair quote diya jata hai; repair karwane par visit fee adjust hoti hai
Lens cleaning, connector re-crimping aur camera angle reset
Mobile app reconnection aur password reset (owner proof zaroori)

visit-and-diagnosis.description: Technician visit, poore system ka check, likha hua repair quote. Visit fee repair bill mein adjust hogi.

faqs.question: ₹299 visit fee kis cheez ki hai?
faqs.answer: Ismein aane-jaane ka kharcha aur poora fault check shamil hai. Agar aap repair approve karte hain, to yeh final bill mein adjust ho jati hai.

faqs.question: Mere camera mein "No Video" aa raha hai. Aam taur par iski wajah kya hoti hai?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar loose connector, kharab power adapter ya damage cable. Kabhi-kabhi camera khud kharab hota hai.

faqs.question: Main DVR ka password bhool gaya hoon. Kya aap reset kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan. Humein proof chahiye ki system aapka hai (purchase bill ya site address wala ID). Kuch brand ke liye brand se reset code lena padta hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap kisi aur ke lagaye system bhi repair karte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan. Hum CP Plus, Hikvision, Dahua aur zyadatar dusre brand ki service karte hain, chahe kisi ne bhi lagaya ho.

faqs.question: AMC mein kya cover hota hai?
faqs.answer: Saal mein 4 planned visit, cleaning, recording aur app check, aur routine fault ka labour. Parts ka kharcha alag lagta hai.

wifi-camera-installation.name: Wi-Fi Camera Setup
wifi-camera-installation.shortDescription: CP Plus ezyKam, Imou, Qubo ya Mi jaise smart Wi-Fi camera ki fitting aur app setup.
wifi-camera-installation.fullDescription: Ek room, dukaan ke counter ya main gate ke liye sahi hai, jab aapko pura DVR system nahi chahiye. Technician us jagah par Wi-Fi signal check karega, camera ko deewar ya chhat par lagayega (ya shelf par rakhega), memory card daal kar format karega, camera ko aapke router se connect karega, aur brand ka app setup karega, alerts aur family ke saath sharing ke saath. Agar signal kamzor hai, to router se LAN cable laga sakte hain. Camera isme shamil nahi hai, jab tak aap use add nahi karte.

faqs.question: 128 GB card kitne din record karega?
faqs.answer: Normal 1080p camera mein lagatar recording par lagbhag ek hafta. Motion-only mode mein zyada din chalega.

faqs.question: Kya light jaane par kaam karega?
faqs.answer: Nahi, jab tak plug point inverter ya UPS backup par na ho. Hum ise inverter wale point ke paas laga sakte hain.

faqs.question: Jahan camera lagana hai, wahan Wi-Fi kamzor hai.
faqs.answer: Hum router se LAN cable laga sakte hain ya Wi-Fi extender suggest kar sakte hain. Dono ka charge alag se lagega.

faqs.question: Kya meri family bhi camera dekh sakti hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Hum unhe app ke share option se add kar dete hain.

faqs.question: Meri dukaan ke liye HD cameras ya IP?
faqs.answer: Ek kamre mein 8 cameras tak ke liye HD aur DVR sasta padta hai aur achha chalta hai. Zyada saaf video, bade jagah ya aage cameras badhane ke liye IP behtar hai.

faqs.question: Kya counter ki awaaz sun sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, audio cameras (built-in mic) se. Survey ke time bata dijiye taaki sahi recorder chuna jaa sake.

faqs.question: Kya ek phone se do branch dekh sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan. Dono recorders ek hi brand ke app mein add ho sakte hain.

faqs.question: Kya installation se business mein dikkat hogi?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar dukaan ka kaam aadhe din mein ho jaata hai. Pehle se tay karne par hum dukaan khulne se pehle ya band hone ke baad kaam shuru kar sakte hain.

tap-faucet-repair.name: Tap aur Faucet Repair
tap-faucet-repair.shortDescription: Leak, tapakne wale ya dheele tap theek karwayein, ya aapka kharida hua naya tap ya sink mixer lagwayein.
tap-faucet-repair.fullDescription: Tapakta hua tap paani barbaad karta hai aur motor ko zyada der chalna padta hai. Hamara plumber tap check karta hai, kharabi ki wajah dhoondhta hai (ghisa hua washer, spindle, cartridge ya dheela body) aur wahin repair kar deta hai. Agar tap repair ke laayak nahi hai, to hum naya tap laga dete hain. Ye tap aap khud la sakte hain, ya hum dukaan ke bill ke price par kharid kar la denge. Hum kitchen sink mixer, wall-mixer, extension nozzle aur aerator bhi lagate hain. Price per tap hai, sirf labour ka. Washer ya cartridge jaise parts ka kharcha actual cost par alag se lagega.

faqs.question: Kya mujhe pehle tap khareedna hoga?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Aap khud khareed sakte hain, ya plumber local dukaan se khareed lega aur aap dukaan ka bill pay kar dena.

faqs.question: Tap ko tight band karne ke baad bhi paani tapakta hai. Kya ye theek ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar haan. Jyadatar tapakna ghise hue washer ya cartridge se hota hai, jo sasta part hai.

faqs.question: Kya price per tap hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, labour per tap hai. Agar kai tap mein kaam hai to 3-tap combo sasta padta hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap concealed (deewar ke andar wala) tap body theek kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Plumber jaanch karke quote dega. Agar tiles kholni padein, to uska quote kaam shuru karne se pehle alag se diya jayega.

faqs.question: Kya paani ki supply band hogi?
faqs.answer: Thodi der ke liye. Kaam ke dauraan plumber main valve band karega ya motor rok dega.

shower-mixer-repair.name: Shower aur Mixer Repair
shower-mixer-repair.shortDescription: Shower, hand shower, diverter aur bathroom wall mixer ki repair ya fitting, taaki garam aur thanda paani barabar aaye.
shower-mixer-repair.fullDescription: Paani kam aana, diverter atak jaana ya shower head ke joint se leak hona aam problem hain. Ye aksar hard water ke scale ki wajah se hoti hain. Hamara plumber shower head saaf ya repair karta hai, arm aur hose ka leak theek karta hai, aur diverter ya mixer cartridge repair ya change karta hai. Hum naya overhead shower, hand shower, shower filter aur deewar par lagne wala hot-and-cold mixer bhi fit karte hain. Price mein sirf labour shamil hai. Naya shower, hose ya cartridge laagat par bill hoga, ya aap khud de sakte hain.
bullets: Shower head ka scale saaf karna aur leak theek karna
Diverter / mixer cartridge repair ya change (part ka kharcha alag)

shower-mixer-diverter-installation-or-ca.description: Shower mixer ya diverter ki installation, ya cartridge change

excludes: Naye concealed hot/cold lines ya tile cutting

faqs.question: Mere shower mein paani kam kyun aata hai?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par scale nozzles ya filter ko block kar deta hai. Aksar safai se theek ho jaata hai. Tanki kam unchai par ho to bhi pressure kam ho sakta hai.

faqs.question: Agar mere paas sirf cold line hai to kya aap mixer fit kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Hot-and-cold mixer ke liye dono lines chahiye. Hot line jodna naya fitting ka kaam hai aur uska quote alag diya jaata hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap Jaquar ya Cera jaise branded mixer repair karte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, labour utna hi lagta hai. Brand ka cartridge model se match hona chahiye, isliye purana cartridge ya model number saath rakhein.

faqs.question: Kya shower filter Patna ke hard water mein madad karta hai?
faqs.answer: Ye chlorine aur kuch mitti/sediment kam karta hai. Filter cartridge ko time-time par badalna padta hai. Company ki guidance follow karein.

faqs.question: Kya geyser repair shamil hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Plumbing mein sirf geyser ka paani wala connection cover hota hai.

toilet-repair-installation.name: Toilet Repair aur Installation
toilet-repair-installation.shortDescription: Lagatar chalne wala flush tank, leakage aur seat theek karwayein, ya western aur Indian toilet sahi sealing ke saath install karwayein.
toilet-repair-installation.fullDescription: Lagatar chalta flush roz saikdon litre paani barbaad karta hai, aur dheela commode base se leak kar sakta hai. Hamara plumber flush tank repair karta hai (andar ki fittings, push button, handle), bahar wala PVC cistern badalta hai, seat cover aur jet spray fit karta hai, aur Indian (squat) aur western (floor ya wall-mounted) toilet repair ya install karta hai. Installation mein fixing, soil outlet aur water inlet ka connection, aur sealing shamil hai. Toilet pot, cistern, seat aur fittings ka kharcha alag hai; aap khud de sakte hain ya hum shop rate par khareed denge.

faqs.question: Mera flush lagatar chalta rehta hai. Ye repair hoga ya replacement?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar repair. Ghisa hua inlet valve ya outlet seal badla jata hai; poora cistern sirf tabhi badla jata hai jab wo crack ho.

faqs.question: Kya aap Indian toilet ko western mein badal sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, lekin floor todna aur dobara level karna padta hai. Plumber pehle check karke fixed quote deta hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap wall-mounted (wall-hung) toilet install karte hain?
faqs.answer: Repair haan. Naye wall-hung unit ke liye concealed frame chahiye hota hai, isliye inspection ke baad quote diya jata hai.

faqs.question: Installation ke kitni der baad toilet use kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par cement ya sealant set hone ke baad, aksar kuch ghante mein. Plumber aapko sahi time batayega.

faqs.question: Kya installation mein seat cover shamil hai?
faqs.answer: Agar aapke paas seat cover hai to uski fitting shamil hai; seat ka kharcha alag hai.

water-tank-installation-cleaning.name: Water Tank Installation aur Cleaning
water-tank-installation-cleaning.shortDescription: Chhat par naya plastic tank (Sintex-type) inlet, outlet aur overflow ke saath lagwayein, ya tank ki cleaning karwayein.
water-tank-installation-cleaning.fullDescription: Hum aapke chhat par pehle se bane platform ya stand par naya overhead plastic water tank fit karte hain. Motor se inlet, ghar ki line tak outlet, overflow aur drain valve jodte hain, aur leak check karte hain. Hum purane tank badalte hain, tank connection ka leak aur float valve theek karte hain, aur overhead, loft aur underground tank ki cleaning bhi karte hain. Cleaning mein tank khali karna, jama hua keechad ragadkar saaf karna aur paani se dhona shamil hai. Tank, pipe, valve aur fittings ka kharcha alag hai. Tank ko upar ki manzil tak le jaane ke liye extra helpers lag sakte hain. Ye hum booking se pehle confirm kar dete hain.

faqs.question: Kya tank aap dete hain?
faqs.answer: Aap tank dealer ya brand ki site se khareed sakte hain. Aap chahein to hum bill price par tank la sakte hain.

faqs.question: Tank ko chhat tak kaun le jaata hai?
faqs.answer: Normal ghar mein ye kaam hamari team karti hai. 3 ya usse zyada manzil ho ya seedhi nahi ho, to extra helpers ka quote booking se pehle diya jaata hai.

faqs.question: Kya platform zaroori hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Paani se bhara 1,000 L tank ek tonne se zyada bhaari hota hai. Ise samtal aur mazboot platform ya stand par hi rakhna chahiye.

faqs.question: Tank kitne din mein saaf karwana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar ghar har 3–6 mahine mein saaf karwate hain. Paani gandla dikhe ya badboo aaye to isse jaldi karwayein.

faqs.question: Cleaning ke time paani band rahega kya?
faqs.answer: Haan, ek-do ghante ke liye. Pehle se baalti mein thoda paani bhar kar rakh lein.

full-home-plumbing.name: Poore Ghar ki Plumbing (Nayi Fitting / Re-piping)
full-home-plumbing.shortDescription: Bathroom aur kitchen ke liye nayi pipe fitting ya re-piping. Site visit ke baad per bathroom ya kitchen ke hisaab se price.
full-home-plumbing.fullDescription: Naye ghar, renovation ya leak karne wali purani GI line ke liye hamari plumbing team nayi CPVC (garam aur thanda paani) aur UPVC (waste aur soil) line bichhati hai. Kaam "points" mein gina jata hai: har woh jagah jahan paani aata hai ya nikalta hai. Ek normal bathroom mein lagbhag 8–12 points hote hain. Hum site survey karte hain, points ginte hain, concealed ya exposed pipework tay karte hain, aur likhit quote dete hain. Deewar band karne se pehle pressure test karke kaam khatam hota hai. Neeche diye labour price mein pipe, fittings, wall chasing repair aur sanitaryware shamil nahi hain.

faqs.question: "Point" kya hota hai?
faqs.answer: Har woh jagah jahan paani nikalta hai ya drain hota hai, jaise garam aur thande paani wala basin do supply point aur ek drain hota hai.

faqs.question: Concealed ya exposed — kaun sa behtar hai?
faqs.answer: Concealed zyada saaf dikhta hai par mehenga hai aur aage repair ke liye tile todni padti hai. Exposed sasta hai aur aasani se pahunch mein rehta hai.

faqs.question: Kya material shamil hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Hum material list dete hain; aap khud khareed sakte hain ya hum bill price par khareed denge. Branded CPVC lene ki salah hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap tiling se pehle test karte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan. Deewar band karne se pehle line ka pressure test hota hai, taaki leak pehle hi pakad mein aa jaye.

faqs.question: Kya aap purane GI pipe badal sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan. Purani GI supply line ko CPVC se badla ja sakta hai; kitni deewar kholni padegi yeh survey se tay hota hai.

faqs.question: Payment kaise hota hai?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par quote ke baad advance aur kaam poora hone par baaki, online ya cash.

home-wiring-rewiring.name: Full Home Wiring
home-wiring-rewiring.shortDescription: Naye point, extra wiring line ya poore ghar ki rewiring, open (casing) ya deewar ke andar concealed.
home-wiring-rewiring.fullDescription: Naya plug point chahiye, kitchen tak nayi line, ya purane ghar ki poori rewiring? Hamara electrician pehle load, purane wire aur main board check karta hai, phir koi bhi kaam shuru hone se pehle aapko likhit quote deta hai. Chhote kaam, jaise PVC casing mein wire lagana, ka charge har 5 metre ke hisaab se lagta hai. Naye point ka charge per point lagta hai. Poore ghar ki rewiring ka quote site visit ke baad per point ya per square foot ke hisaab se diya jata hai. Material aap khud khareed sakte hain, ya hum ISI-mark wala wire, conduit aur switch bill price par la sakte hain.

faqs.question: Open aur concealed wiring mein kya fark hai?
faqs.answer: Open wiring deewar ke upar PVC casing ke andar chalti hai. Yeh jaldi hoti hai aur sasti padti hai. Concealed wiring deewar mein kate groove ke andar chalti hai, isliye zyada saaf dikhti hai, lekin baad mein plaster repair karna padta hai.

faqs.question: Kya wire mujhe khud khareedna padega?
faqs.answer: Aapki marzi hai. Aap khud khareed sakte hain, ya hum ISI-mark wala copper wire aur branded switch la denge aur dukaan ka bill aapke invoice mein jod denge.

faqs.question: Poori rewiring ka rate kaise tay hota hai?
faqs.answer: Site visit ke baad hum point (light, fan, socket, AC line) ginte hain aur per point quote dete hain. Kaam shuru hone se pehle aapko poori rakam bata di jati hai.

faqs.question: 2BHK ki rewiring mein kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par 2 se 5 working din lagte hain. Yeh is par depend karta hai ki wiring concealed hai ya open, deewar kaisi hai aur kitne point badalne hain.

faqs.question: Groove katne ke baad kya aap deewar repair karenge?
faqs.answer: Hum groove ko basic patch se bhar dete hain. Final plaster finish aur paint ka charge alag hai, ya aap inhe alag se book kar sakte hain.

faqs.question: Kya visit charge lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Inspection aur quote ke liye ₹99 lagte hain. Agar aap kaam book karte hain to yeh aapke bill mein adjust ho jata hai.

fan-light-installation.name: Fan Installation aur Lights
fan-light-installation.shortDescription: Ceiling, exhaust aur wall fan, tube light, ceiling light, chandelier aur switchboard lagwayein ya badlwayein.
fan-light-installation.fullDescription: Naya fan ya light liya hai, ya purana badalna hai? Hamara electrician tools lekar aata hai, aapke existing point par fit karta hai, aur jaane se pehle test karta hai. Hum ceiling fan (regular, BLDC aur decorative), exhaust aur wall fan, regulator, tube light, ceiling aur wall light, hanging light aur chandelier lagate hain. Hum kharab switch aur poora switchboard bhi badalte hain. Price per unit hai, existing wiring par. faqs.question: Kya aap fan ya light lekar aate hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Item aap khareedte hain; hum lagate hain. Capacitor ya switch jaise chhote parts hum la sakte hain aur dukaan ka bill jod denge.

faqs.question: Meri chhat mein fan hook nahi hai. Kya phir bhi fan lag sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, lekin naye hook ya clamp ka extra kharcha lagega. Drilling se pehle electrician aapko price bata dega.

faqs.question: Kya purana fan utarne ka charge lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Jab aap fan badal rahe hain, to purana fan utarna included hai. Sirf utarne ka kaam alag chhote job ke roop mein charge hota hai.

faqs.question: Kitna bhaari chandelier laga sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Zyada tar ghar wale chandelier. Bhaari chandelier ke liye chhat mein mazboot anchor chahiye; hum chhat check karke fitting se pehle quote dete hain.

faqs.question: Mere naye BLDC fan ke saath remote hai. Kya aap use set up karenge?
faqs.answer: Haan. Hum remote pair karte hain aur jaane se pehle saari speeds aur light modes test karte hain.

inverter-ups-service.name: Inverter aur UPS
inverter-ups-service.shortDescription: Inverter aur home UPS ki installation, battery badalna, backup ke liye ghar ki wiring, check-up aur repair.
inverter-ups-service.fullDescription: Power cut to aksar hota hai, isliye chalta hua inverter zaroori hai. Hamara electrician naya inverter ya home UPS uski battery ke saath lagata hai, jin lines ko aap backup par chahte hain unse connect karta hai, aur charging aur changeover check karta hai. Hum purane unit ko shift ya remove bhi karte hain, battery badalte hain, distilled water top-up karte hain, terminal saaf karte hain, aur jab backup time kam ho jaye ya unit beep kare to fault dhoondhte hain. faqs.question: Kya inverter ke liye alag wiring chahiye?

faqs.question: Battery ki service kitni baar karani chahiye?
faqs.answer: Water level regular check karte rahein, garmi mein aur zyada baar, aur terminal saaf rakhein. Top-up sirf distilled water se karein. Hamara technician aapko tarika dikha sakta hai.

faqs.question: Mera backup time kam ho gaya hai. Kya battery kharab ho gayi?
faqs.answer: Hamesha nahi. Kam paani, loose terminal ya galat charging setting se bhi aisa hota hai. Check-up se pata chalta hai ki service karani hai ya battery badalni hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap inverter ya battery bechte hain?
faqs.answer: Aap inhe kisi bhi dukaan ya brand se kharidein. Hum install aur connect karte hain. Aapke load ke hisaab se sahi capacity suggest kar sakte hain.

faqs.question: Kya brand warranty valid rahegi?
faqs.answer: Brand warranty brand ki apni sharton par chalti hai. Apna purchase bill rakhein aur hume book karne se pehle check kar lein ki brand apna installer to nahi maangta.

faqs.answer: Hafte mein zyada se zyada ek ya do baar. Zyada scrub karne se skin mein irritation ho sakta hai.

faqs.question: Kya main sirf scrub book kar sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Ye haircut ya beard trim ke saath add-on ke roop mein sabse achha hai, kyunki visit chhota hota hai.

faqs.question: Mujhe acne hai. Kya scrub theek hai?
faqs.answer: Active pimples par scrub na karein. Groomer un jagahon ko chhod dega.

faqs.question: Scrub lein ya cleanup?
faqs.answer: Scrub jaldi hone wali upar ki care hai. Cleanup mein steam, blackhead nikalna aur pack bhi hota hai.

hair-styling-care.name: Haircut aur Styling
hair-styling-care.shortDescription: Mahilaon ke liye ghar par haircut, trim ya blow-dry, trained stylist saaf tools ke saath karegi.
hair-styling-care.fullDescription: Stylist aapke ghar scissors, comb, dryer aur straightener lekar aati hai. Pehle aap batate hain ki aapko kaisa look chahiye. Stylist aapke baal ki length aur texture check karti hai, phir cut ya trim karti hai. Agar aap styling book karte hain, to aapke baal blow-dry karke straight kiye jaate hain, soft in/out curls diye jaate hain, ya smooth finish ke liye iron kiye jaate hain. Visit se pehle aapke baal dhule hue aur sookhe hone chahiye, jab tak aap wash book na karein. Kaam ke baad stylist gire hue baal saaf karti hai. Ye monthly trim, naye cut, ya kisi function ki taiyari ke liye sahi hai.

faqs.question: Kya stylist ke aane se pehle mujhe baal dhone chahiye?
faqs.answer: Haan. Baal saaf aur poori tarah sookhe rakhein, jab tak aap booking mein hair wash add na karein.

faqs.question: Kya meri beti ka cut bhi ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Usi booking mein girls' haircut add kar dijiye, taaki ek hi stylist ek visit mein dono haircut kar de.

faqs.question: Stylist kya-kya laati hai?
faqs.answer: Scissors, combs, clips, cape, dryer aur straightener ya curling tong. Aapko bas power socket ke paas ek chair aur ek mirror chahiye.

faqs.question: Styling kitne din tak tikti hai?
faqs.answer: Blow-dry ya ironing aam taur par agle wash tak tikti hai. Humidity aur paseene se ye jaldi utar sakti hai.

faqs.question: Kya main reference photo dikha sakti hoon?
faqs.answer: Haan. Shuru mein hi share kar dijiye. Stylist aapko imaandari se batayegi ki aapke baal ki length ya texture us style ke liye sahi hai ya nahi.

hair-smoothening-keratin.name: Hair Straightening — Smoothening / Keratin / Botox
hair-smoothening-keratin.shortDescription: Ghar par keratin, smoothening ya hair botox, frizz-free aur aasani se sambhalne wale baalon ke liye. Price baalon ki lambai par depend karta hai.
hair-smoothening-keratin.fullDescription: Ye treatments frizz kam karte hain aur baalon ko hafton ya mahinon tak sambhalna aasan banate hain. Keratin aur botox baalon par coat karke heat se seal karte hain, isliye baal smooth aur shiny dikhte hain, lekin bilkul seedhe (poker-straight) nahi hote. Smoothening mein zyada strong chemical step hota hai, isliye baal zyada seedhe hote hain aur badlav zyada din tak rehta hai. Stylist aapke baal wash karta hai, section by section product lagata hai, blow-dry karta hai aur phir treatment seal karne ke liye patle sections mein iron karta hai. Isme 3–4 hr lagte hain, isliye ek khaali dopahar plan karein. Aftercare zaroori hai: sulphate-free shampoo aur conditioner use karein.
bullets: Shuru karne se pehle baalon ki lambai check aur strand test
Wash, product lagana, blow-dry aur seal karne ke liye patle sections mein ironing
Branded professional products (brand ka naam booking par likha hoga)
Aftercare advice: sulphate-free shampoo aur pehli baar kab wash karein

faqs.question: Keratin ya smoothening, kaun sa chunun?
faqs.answer: Keratin halka hota hai aur baalon ki kuch natural movement bani rehti hai. Smoothening se baal zyada seedhe hote hain aur zyada din chalta hai, lekin isme strong chemical lagta hai. Stylist aapke baal dekhkar ek suggest karega.

faqs.question: Ye kitne din tak chalta hai?
faqs.answer: Ye product, aapke baal aur aap kitni baar wash karte hain, is par depend karta hai. Product kitne din chalega, ye stylist se poochein. Sulphate-free shampoo se ye zyada din tak chalta hai.

faqs.question: Baal kab wash kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Jo product use hua hai uske hisaab se stylist jo bataye wahi follow karein. Aam taur par kuch din rukna hota hai. Uske baad sirf sulphate-free shampoo use karein.

faqs.question: Kya coloured baalon par ye safe hai?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par haan. Stylist ko koi bhi colour, mehendi ya pehle hua chemical treatment zaroor batayein, taaki wo pehle strand test kar sake.

faqs.question: Final price listed price se alag kyun hai?
faqs.answer: Listed price dikhayi gayi lambai ke liye hai. Lambe ya ghane baalon mein zyada product lagta hai. Stylist shuru karne se pehle price confirm karta hai.

hair-colour-at-home.name: Hair Coloring — Root Touch-up / Global / Highlights
hair-colour-at-home.shortDescription: Ghar par root touch-up, poore baalon ka colour ya highlights, L'Oréal professional shades se ya aapke apne colour se.
hair-colour-at-home.fullDescription: Ek trained stylist aapke ghar aakar baalon mein colour karti hai. Wo shade chunne mein aapki madad karti hai, scalp check karti hai, aur agar aap is brand ka colour pehli baar laga rahe hain to patch test bhi karti hai. Root touch-up mein scalp ke paas naye safed baal cover hote hain. Global colour mein saare baal ek hi shade mein colour hote hain. Highlights ya balayage mein kuch strands halke colour ke hote hain, jisse look soft lagta hai. Stylist L'Oréal Majirel ya ammonia-free Inoa range use karti hai, colour section-by-section lagati hai, phir baal dhoti hai aur conditioning karke chhodti hai. Agar aapke paas pehle se koi pasand ka colour hai, to aap sirf application book kar sakte hain.
bullets: Shade ke liye salah, aur maangne par patch test
Sealed L'Oréal Majirel ya Inoa (ammonia-free) colour, ya aapka apna colour lagaya jayega
Section-by-section barabar application, timing check karke
Baad mein baal dhona aur conditioning; stylist floor aur furniture ko cover karke rakhti hai

colour-application-only.title: Sirf colour application
colour-application-only.description: Aapke apne colour product ka application

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: L'Oréal, kandhe tak lambe baal (120–150 min)

faqs.question: Majirel aur Inoa mein kya fark hai?
faqs.answer: Dono L'Oréal Professionnel ke colour hain. Inoa mein ammonia nahi hota, isliye iski smell halki hoti hai aur ye zyada gentle lagta hai, aur thoda mehenga hai. Majirel safed baalon ko achhe se cover karta hai.

faqs.question: Kya patch test zaroori hai?
faqs.answer: Agar aap kisi brand ko pehli baar use kar rahe hain ya aapka scalp sensitive hai, to hum patch test ki salah dete hain. Ise colour visit se 1–2 din pehle book karein.

faqs.question: Kya main apna colour use kar sakti hoon?
faqs.answer: Haan. "Application only" book karein. Stylist use karne se pehle check karegi ki pack sealed hai aur expiry date nahi nikli hai.

faqs.question: Kya floor ya towel par daag lagega?
faqs.answer: Stylist jagah aur aapke kandhon ko cover karti hai. Purani T-shirt pehnein, kyunki colour se kapde par daag lag sakta hai.

faqs.question: Root touch-up kitne din mein karwana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Zyada tar logon ko har 4–6 hafte mein karwana padta hai. Ye is par depend karta hai ki baal kitni jaldi badhte hain aur kitne safed baal dikhte hain.

facial-cleanup.name: Facial & Cleanup
facial-cleanup.shortDescription: Ghar par cleanup ya facial, Lotus, O3+ ya aise hi professional products ke saath, aapki skin type ke hisaab se chune hue.
facial-cleanup.fullDescription: Beautician aapke ghar aati hai aur pehle aapki skin ke baare mein poochti hai: oily, dry, sensitive, tanned ya dull. Cleanup ek chhota routine hai: cleansing, scrubbing, steam, blackhead removal aur mask. Facial mein lambi massage, serum aur treatment mask bhi hota hai, isliye isse zyada gehra glow aata hai. Products Lotus Professional aur O3+ jaise professional ranges ke hote hain, jo aapke saamne khole jaate hain. Disposable sheets aur wipes use hote hain. Shuru karne se pehle beautician ko acne, allergy ya skin ki koi dawai ho to zaroor batayein.
bullets: Product chunne se pehle jaldi se skin type check
Cleanse, scrub, steam, blackhead removal, massage aur mask (facial)
Lotus Professional aur O3+ jaise professional brands, saath mein fruit ya herbal options
Disposable sheets aur wipes; kaam ke baad jagah saaf ki jaati hai
Facial ke baad sunscreen ki salah
excludes: Usi din bleach ya de-tan (kuch facials ke saath bleach nahi karna chahiye, FAQ dekhein)

faqs.question: Cleanup ya facial, mujhe kaun sa chahiye?
faqs.answer: Cleanup ek jaldi hone wala monthly refresh hai. Facial mein zyada time lagta hai, zyada massage aur treatment mask hota hai. Kisi event se pehle ya skin dull lage to facial chunein.

faqs.question: Kya facial ke saath bleach karwa sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Sirf kuch facials ke saath. Brightening facials ke saath bleach nahi karna chahiye. Aapne jo facial book kiya hai uske liye kya safe hai, ye beautician bata degi.

faqs.question: Aap kaun se brands use karte hain?
faqs.answer: O3+ aur Lotus Professional jaise professional ranges. Product ka naam aapki booking par hota hai, aur sealed packs aapke saamne khole jaate hain.

faqs.question: Mujhe acne hai ya skin sensitive hai. Kya main book kar sakti hoon?
faqs.answer: Booking ke time humein batayein. Kuch brightening facials sensitive ya acne wali skin ke liye sahi nahi hain. Uski jagah halka cleanup chunein.

faqs.question: Baad mein kya karna chahiye?
faqs.answer: Baaki din makeup aur tez dhoop se bachein, aur sunscreen lagayein. Do-teen din tak chehre par scrub na karein.

face-bleach-at-home.name: Face Bleach
face-bleach-at-home.shortDescription: Ghar par face aur neck ka gentle bleach, jisse chehre ke halke baal kam dikhen aur skin tone ek jaisa lage.
face-bleach-at-home.fullDescription: Bleach chehre ke halke baalon ka rang halka kar deta hai, jisse woh skin mein mil jaate hain, aur skin tone zyada ek jaisa dikhta hai. Beautician pehle aapka chehra saaf karti hain. Agar aap yeh product pehli baar use kar rahe hain to jaldi se patch test karti hain, phir thoda sa fresh bleach mix karti hain. Ise face aur neck par lagakar kuch minute chhoda jaata hai, phir pochh kar soothing pack se thanda kiya jaata hai. Hum face ke liye safe bleach cream jaise Oxylife ya O3+ use karte hain. Isi visit mein aap threading ya cleanup bhi saath mein karwa sakte hain.
bullets: Pehli baar karwane walon ya sensitive skin walon ke liye patch test
Fresh mix kiya hua face-safe bleach (jaise Oxylife, O3+)
Face aur neck cover hota hai, arms ya back alag se add kar sakte hain
Baad mein soothing pack aur sunscreen ki salah
excludes: Kuch brightening facial ke baad usi din bleach (allowed nahi hai)
Kati-phati, sunburn wali ya abhi-abhi wax ki hui skin par bleach

faqs.question: Kya bleach se baal hat jaate hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Yeh halke baalon ka rang halka karta hai, jisse woh kam dikhte hain. Baal hatane ke liye threading ya waxing karwaiye.

faqs.question: Kya isse jalan hogi?
faqs.answer: Halki chubhan normal hai. Agar jalan ho to turant beautician ko bataiye. Woh use pochh kar hata dengi.

faqs.question: Kya waxing ya facial ke baad bleach karwa sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Abhi-abhi wax ki hui skin par bleach mat karwaiye. Kuch brightening facial ke baad bleach nahi karna chahiye. Aapne kya book kiya hai, beautician check kar lengi.

faqs.question: Kitne din mein bleach karwa sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par lagbhag har 3–4 hafte mein ek baar. Do session ke beech skin ko theek hone ka time dijiye.

detan-at-home.name: De-Tan Treatment
detan-at-home.shortDescription: Ghar par face, neck ya arms ke liye de-tan pack, dhoop ka tan aur dullness kam karne ke liye.
detan-at-home.fullDescription: Bihar mein dhoop bahut tez hoti hai, aur face, neck, arms aur pairon par tan jam jata hai. De-tan treatment mein ek cream ya pack lagaya jata hai jo dead aur tan wali skin ko dheela karta hai aur dullness hatata hai. Beautician pehle us jagah ko saaf karti hai, de-tan pack lagati hai, kuch minute tak use kaam karne deti hai, phir hata kar ek soothing mask se finish karti hai. Ismein bleach use nahi hota, isliye ye un logon ke liye sahi hai jo bleach se bachna chahte hain. Aur gehra result chahiye to anti-tan cleanup chunein, jismein steam, scrub aur mask bhi hota hai.

Face aur neck, ya saath mein arms, pair ya back add karein

faqs.question: Kya de-tan aur bleach ek hi cheez hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. De-tan tan wali dead skin hatata hai. Bleach chehre ke baalon ka rang halka karta hai. De-tan un logon ke liye sahi hai jo bleach se bachna chahte hain.

faqs.question: Kya ek session mein mera saara tan hat jayega?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par skin turant zyada saaf aur chamakdar dikhti hai. Zyada tan ho to kuch sessions aur roz sunscreen ki zaroorat pad sakti hai.

faqs.question: Kya main waxing ke saath de-tan karwa sakti hoon?
faqs.answer: Haan. Bahut log waxing ke baad arms par de-tan book karte hain. Jahan skin irritated ho, beautician wo jagah chhod degi.

faqs.question: Kya ye sensitive skin ke liye safe hai?
faqs.answer: Booking ke time humein bata dein. Beautician patch test karegi aur zaroorat ho to halka pack chun sakti hai.

eyebrow-threading-at-home.name: Eyebrow Grooming — Threading
eyebrow-threading-at-home.shortDescription: Ghar par eyebrow shaping aur face threading. Ise kisi bhi salon booking ke saath add kar sakte hain.
eyebrow-threading-at-home.fullDescription: Beautician cotton thread se aapke chehre ke hisaab se eyebrows ka shape banati hai, phir aap kahen to upper lip, forehead, chin ya full face bhi saaf karti hai. Threading mein koi chemical use nahi hota, isliye ye sensitive skin ke liye sahi hai aur brow lines ekdum sharp aati hain. Har customer ke liye naya thread use hota hai. Baad mein soothing gel ya toner lagaya jaata hai jisse redness kam ho jaati hai. Threading jaldi ho jaati hai aur sasti hai, isliye ise aam taur par facial, waxing ya haircut visit ke saath add kiya jaata hai.
bullets: Shuru karne se pehle brow ka shape aapke saath tay kiya jaata hai

Aap kahen to upper lip, forehead, chin, sides ya full face
Baad mein soothing gel ya toner

faqs.question: Kya main sirf eyebrows book kar sakti hoon?
faqs.answer: Threading aam taur par kisi doosri service ke saath add ki jaati hai. Home visit ke liye minimum booking value lag sakti hai.

faqs.question: Brows ke liye threading sahi hai ya waxing?
faqs.answer: Threading mein shape par zyada control rehta hai aur koi chemical use nahi hota, isliye sensitive skin ke liye ye aksar behtar hoti hai.

faqs.question: Kya meri skin laal ho jayegi?
faqs.answer: Thodi redness normal hai aur aam taur par 1 ghante mein chali jaati hai. Kuch ghante tak us jagah par makeup na lagayen.

faqs.question: Threading kitne din mein karwani chahiye?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar log har 2–4 hafte mein karwate hain, ye is par depend karta hai ki aapke baal kitni jaldi badhte hain.

full-body-waxing.name: Full Body Waxing
full-body-waxing.shortDescription: Trained lady beautician aapke ghar par full arms, underarms, legs, pet aur back ki waxing karti hai.
full-body-waxing.fullDescription: Lady beautician naye wax kit aur disposable spatula aur strips ke saath aapke ghar aati hai. Woh ek hi baar mein full arms, underarms, full legs, pet aur back ki waxing karti hai. Normal skin ke liye honey wax lein. Agar skin sensitive hai ya aapko kam khinchav chahiye to Rica / roll-on wax lein. Bikini aur bikini line is package mein nahi hain, inhe alag se add kar sakte hain. Pehle 3–5 hafte tak baal badhne dein aur beech mein shave na karein. Lagbhag 90 minute ka time rakhein aur room mein fan ya AC chalu rakhein.
bullets: Lady beautician apne kit, sheet aur wipes ke saath aapke ghar aati hai
Har dip ke liye naya spatula, wax pot mein double-dipping nahi
Honey, Rica ya chocolate roll-on wax mein se choose karein
Wax ke baad sabhi jagah par soothing lotion/wipe
excludes: Service area se bahar ka travel (agar lagu ho)

faqs.question: Baal kitne lambe hone chahiye?
faqs.answer: Lagbhag 3–5 hafte ki growth sabse sahi rehti hai. Bahut chhote baal nikalna mushkil hota hai aur dard zyada hota hai. Visit se pehle trim ya shave na karein.

faqs.question: Rica ya honey — kaun sa lein?
faqs.answer: Honey zyada tar skin par suit karta hai aur kam price ka hai. Rica zyada gentle hai aur sensitive ya dry skin ke liye better hai, isliye mehenga hai.

faqs.question: Kya bikini waxing included hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Bikini aur bikini line peel-off wax ke saath alag add-on hain.

faqs.question: Kya pregnancy mein waxing kara sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par haan, lekin beautician ko pehle bata dein. Us time skin zyada sensitive hoti hai; agar doubt ho to doctor se pooch lein.

faqs.question: Ghar par kya intezaam karna hai?
faqs.answer: Thanda room (fan/AC), ek chair ya bed jiske aas-paas jagah ho, aur baad mein dhone ke liye bathroom.

faqs.question: Kitne din mein waxing karani chahiye?
faqs.answer: Zyada tar log har 4–6 hafte mein karate hain. Pehli baar karane wale shuru ke kuch round har 2–3 hafte mein karate hain.

half-body-waxing.name: Half Body Waxing
half-body-waxing.shortDescription: Full arms, underarms aur full legs ki waxing ghar par — sabse zyada book hone wala waxing combo.
half-body-waxing.fullDescription: Ismein woh areas cover hote hain jo zyadatar ladies har mahine wax karwati hain: full arms, underarms aur full legs. Beautician apna wax heater, disposable spatula aur strips khud laati hai, aur end mein soothing wipe se finish karti hai. Kam price ke liye honey wax chunein, sensitive skin ke liye Rica, ya jaldi aur kam gandagi wale session ke liye chocolate roll-on. Underarms peel-off wax se kiye jaate hain, jo chhote baalon ko achhe se pakadta hai aur patli skin ke liye zyada aaram wala hai. Stomach, back aur bikini add karwa sakte hain. Lagbhag ek ghanta lagega.
bullets: Full arms + underarms + full legs ek hi visit mein
Underarms ke liye peel-off wax
Honey, Rica ya roll-on — aapki pasand
Add-ons: stomach, back, bikini line, face

faqs.question: Kya underarms included hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, yahan full arms mein underarms bhi shamil hain, jo peel-off wax se kiye jaate hain.

faqs.question: Roll-on ka matlab kya hai?
faqs.answer: Wax ek garam cartridge mein aata hai jise skin par roll kiya jaata hai. Isse patli, barabar layer lagti hai aur pot wax se kam gandagi hoti hai.

faqs.question: Kya isse tan hatega?
faqs.answer: Waxing skin ki upar ki patli layer utaar deti hai, isliye halka tan aksar kam dikhne lagta hai. Lekin yeh detan treatment nahi hai.

faqs.question: Kya waxing ke baad naha sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Gungune paani ka use karein, aur lagbhag ek din tak soap scrub, dhoop aur swimming se bachein.

faqs.question: Maine pichhle hafte shave kiya tha. Kya phir bhi book kar sakti hoon?
faqs.answer: Behtar hai 2–3 hafte aur ruk jaayein. Chhote, khoonti jaise baal pakadna mushkil hota hai.

leg-waxing.name: Leg Waxing
leg-waxing.shortDescription: Ghar par half ya full leg waxing, honey ya Rica wax ke saath.
leg-waxing.fullDescription: Agar aapko sirf legs ki waxing chahiye, to sirf legs book kariye. Half legs ka matlab hai pair ki ungli se ghutne tak; full legs pair ki ungli se jaangh ke upar tak hota hai, lekin isme bikini line shaamil nahi hai. Beautician pehle skin saaf karti hai, phir hisse-hisse mein wax lagati hai, strips se hatati hai aur aakhir mein aaram dene wale wipe se saaf karti hai. Honey wax budget wala option hai; Rica dry ya sensitive skin ke liye zyada naram hai. Half legs mein lagbhag 20 minute aur full legs mein lagbhag 30 minute lagte hain.

faqs.question: Half legs kahan tak hota hai?
faqs.answer: Ghutne tak. Ghutne ke upar ka hissa full legs mein aata hai.

faqs.question: Kya full legs mein bikini line shaamil hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi, wo alag add-on hai.

faqs.question: Kya waxing se baal mote hokar wapas aate hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Waxing baal ko jad se nikalti hai, isliye naye baal aksar patle aate hain. Shaving se baal mote mehsoos hote hain.

faqs.question: Waxing ke baad meri skin laal ho jaati hai. Kya ye normal hai?
faqs.answer: Halki laali ya chhote daane aksar kuch ghante mein theek ho jaate hain. Us din garam paani, dhoop aur tight kapdon se bachiye.

face-waxing.name: Face Waxing
face-waxing.shortDescription: Upper lip, chin, sidelocks, forehead ya full face ke liye peel-off wax, ghar par aaram se kiya jata hai.
face-waxing.fullDescription: Chehre ki skin patli hoti hai, isliye face waxing mein peel-off (hard) wax use hota hai. faqs.question: Kya aap original parts use karte hain?
faqs.answer: Hum brand-original ya utni hi quality ke parts use karte hain aur lagane se pehle price dikhate hain.

Defrost sensor, thermostat aur relay jaise common parts ke fixed price hain. Kaam shuru hone se pehle aap quote approve karte hain.

faqs.answer: Aksar fan ya defrost system kharab ho jaata hai aur barf air duct ko band kar deti hai. Check-up se pata chalta hai ki kaun sa part kharab hai.

faqs.question: Kya gas charging se theek ho jayega?
faqs.answer: Sirf tab jab gas kam ho. Hum pehle test karte hain taaki aapko bina zaroorat gas ke paise na dene padein.

faqs.question: Double-door ki gas mehngi kyun hai?
faqs.answer: System bada hota hai, pipe lambe hote hain aur vacuum aur charging mein zyada time lagta hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap sab brands repair karte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan — LG, Samsung, Whirlpool, Godrej, Haier, Panasonic, Bosch aur baaki brands bhi.

faqs.question: Mujhe kitni warranty milegi?
faqs.answer: Gas aur compressor ke kaam par 90 din, baaki repair par 30 din.

faqs.question: Kya side-by-side fridge ghar par repair ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar kaam, haan. Board repair ke liye workshop mein ek din lag sakta hai.

faqs.question: Parts mehenge kyun hain?
faqs.answer: In models mein brand-specific inverter boards aur compressors lagte hain jo Patna mein local market mein nahi milte.

faqs.question: Part aane mein kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Common parts usi din; brand parts mein kuch din lag sakte hain. Order karne se pehle hum aapko bata dete hain.

faqs.question: Kya fridge khaali karna padega?
faqs.answer: Gas ya compressor ke kaam ke liye, haan. 3–4 ghante ke liye ek cooler box ready rakhein.

faqs.question: Kya bijli jaane se board kharab ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Voltage upar-neeche hone se ho sakta hai. Stabiliser lagane se board safe rehta hai.

faqs.question: Kaise pata karein ki mera fridge inverter hai?
faqs.answer: Fridge ke andar ka label ya box dekhiye, us par aksar "Inverter" ya "Smart Inverter" likha hota hai. Technician bhi confirm kar sakta hai.

faqs.question: Kya board badalne ki jagah repair ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Aksar haan, aur isme kharcha kam aata hai. Hum pehle repair try karte hain, aur agar board badalna zaroori ho to aapko bata dete hain.

faqs.question: Kya inverter fridge ko stabiliser chahiye?
faqs.answer: Kai fridge wide voltage range par chal jate hain, lekin jahan voltage bahut upar-neeche hota hai, wahan stabiliser se board ko bachane mein madad milti hai.

faqs.question: Kya compressor brand warranty mein cover hota hai?
faqs.answer: Kai brands compressor par lambi warranty dete hain. Pehle apna warranty card check kar lijiye. Agar brand se claim banta lage to hum aapko bata denge.

faqs.question: Aap kaun si gas use karte hain?
faqs.answer: Wahi gas jo aapke fridge ke label par likhi hai, aam taur par R600a ya R134a.

tv-diagnosis-repair-visit.shortDescription: Technician ghar aakar aapke LED/Smart TV ki kharabi dhoondhta hai aur koi bhi repair se pehle likhit quote deta hai.

Chhote kaam jaise loose cable, input/source settings, remote pairing, Wi-Fi ya app ki problem aur software reset usi visit mein kar diye jaate hain. Agar repair mein board, backlight ya panel part lagta hai, to visit fee final repair bill mein adjust ho jaati hai. Hum sabhi bade brands ke LED, LCD, Smart, QLED aur OLED TV ki service karte hain. faqs.question: Kya aap purane CRT (dabba) TV repair karte hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Hum sirf flat-panel TV ki service karte hain: LED, LCD, Smart, QLED aur OLED.

faqs.question: Kya tooti screen theek ho sakti hai?
faqs.answer: Crack panel repair nahi ho sakta, sirf badla ja sakta hai. Panel ka kharcha aksar naye TV ke kareeb hota hai, isliye technician aapko imaandari se batayega agar naya TV lena zyada sahi hai.

faqs.question: Kya TV ghar par hi repair hoga?
faqs.answer: Zyada tar kharabi ghar par hi theek ho jaati hai. Kuch board-level repair mein bench work lagta hai; tab aapki permission se hum TV ya board apne workshop le jaate hain aur wapas kar dete hain.

faqs.question: Mera TV abhi brand warranty mein hai. Kya mujhe booking karni chahiye?
faqs.answer: Pehle brand service centre se contact karein. Bahar ke technician se TV khulwane par brand warranty khatam ho sakti hai.

faqs.question: Kya purana TV repair karwana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Agar TV 8–10 saal se zyada purana hai ya repair ka kharcha naye TV ke price ke kareeb hai, to hum naya lene ki salah denge.

tv-wall-mounting-setup.shortDescription: Aapke LED/Smart TV ki safe wall mounting, drilling, level check, cable ko set karna aur pehli baar ka setup.
tv-wall-mounting-setup.fullDescription: Hamara technician wall check karta hai, dekhne ke liye sahi height mark karta hai, drilling karke bracket fix karta hai aur TV ko seedha (level mein) taangta hai. Phir hum power, set-top box, soundbar ya HDMI devices connect karte hain, channels tune karte hain aur zarurat ho to Wi-Fi aur apps mein sign in karte hain. Price screen size par depend karta hai. TV ke saath aaya bracket rakh kar rakhiye, ya aisa package chuniye jismein standard fixed bracket shamil hai. Ek wall se TV uninstall karna (shifting ke liye) bhi available hai. faqs.question: Kya gypsum ya wooden panel wall par mount kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, sahi anchors ya backing ke saath. Technician jagah par check karta hai; extra hardware ka charge actual cost par lagega.

faqs.question: Mere brand mein free installation milta hai. Kya mujhe booking karni chahiye?
faqs.answer: Agar aapke naye TV ke saath brand ka free installation hai, to pehle wahi use kariye. TV shifting, dobara mounting ya brand visit mein der hone par humein book kariye.

faqs.question: Kya aap wires chhupa denge?
faqs.answer: Hum clips se cables ko set kar dete hain. Wires ko wall ke andar ya conduit mein chhupana alag kaam hai aur iska quote jagah par diya jaata hai.

faqs.question: Kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par 45–60 minute. 65 inch se bade TV mein zyada time lag sakta hai aur do log chahiye.

tv-backlight-repair.name: Backlight aur Screen Flicker Repair
tv-backlight-repair.shortDescription: Awaaz aa rahi hai par screen kaali hai, picture dim hai ya flicker kar rahi hai? Kharab LED backlight strips badal kar theek kiya jaata hai.
tv-backlight-repair.fullDescription: Agar aapke TV mein awaaz aa rahi hai par picture kaali ya bahut dim hai, ya screen flicker karti hai ya us par dark patches dikhte hain, to aksar LED backlight strips kharab hoti hain. Hamara technician pehle torch test aur strip tester se fault confirm karta hai. Uske baad panel ko dhool-free jagah par dhyan se khola jaata hai aur set ki saari strips badli jaati hain, sirf kharab wali nahi, taaki brightness ek jaisi rahe. Price screen size aur brand par depend karta hai. Tuta hua panel, vertical lines aur T-CON fault backlight problem nahi hain, inka quote alag se diya jaata hai.

faqs.answer: Agar awaaz aa rahi hai aur screen ke paas torch jalane par halki picture dikhti hai, to sabse zyada chance hai ki backlight kharab ho gayi hai.

faqs.question: Ek hi strip kharab hai to saari strips kyun badalni?
faqs.answer: Saari strips ek saath purani hoti hain. Poora set badalne se brightness ek jaisi rehti hai aur jaldi dobara TV kholna nahi padta.

faqs.question: Kya yeh kaam ghar par ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: 43 inch tak ka kaam aam taur par ghar par saaf table par ho jaata hai. Bade TV aapki permission se hamare workshop le jaaye ja sakte hain.

faqs.question: Kya warranty milti hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, badli gayi strips par TiptoBook repair warranty milti hai.

faqs.question: Kya repair karwana faydemand hai?
faqs.answer: Backlight repair aam taur par naye panel se kaafi kam kharche mein ho jaata hai. 8 saal se purane TV ke liye hum aapko bata denge agar naya lena zyada sahi rahega.

tv-motherboard-audio-repair.shortDescription: TV on nahi ho raha, baar-baar restart ho raha hai ya sound nahi aa raha? TV ke main board, power board aur sound IC ki chip-level repair ya replacement.
tv-motherboard-audio-repair.fullDescription: Jab TV on nahi hota, baar-baar restart hota hai, logo par atak jaata hai, sound nahi aata ya sound mein kharkharahat aati hai, to aksar kharabi main board (motherboard), power board ya audio amplifier IC mein hoti hai. Hamara technician ghar par hi boards test karta hai. Jahan ho sake, hum component level par repair karte hain (capacitor, IC, regulator, software re-flash). Isme naye board se bahut kam kharcha aata hai. Agar board repair nahi ho sakta, to hum aapke model ke liye tested replacement board ka quote dete hain. Kharab speaker, HDMI aur USB port bhi theek kiye jaate hain. Koi bhi kaam shuru hone se pehle aap price approve karte hain.

faqs.question: Kya TV motherboard repair ho sakta hai ya badalna hi padega?
faqs.answer: Kai kharabiyan (capacitor, power IC, corrupt software) chip level par repair ho sakti hain. Board hum tabhi badalte hain jab repair possible na ho ya bharosemand na ho.

faqs.question: Kabhi-kabhi ek-do din kyun lagte hain?
faqs.answer: Chip-level kaam ke liye bench tools chahiye hote hain. Aapki approval se hum board (hamesha TV nahi) apne workshop le jaate hain aur phir wapas laga dete hain.

faqs.question: Mera TV brand logo par atak gaya hai. Kya ye motherboard ki problem hai?
faqs.answer: Aksar main board ka software ya memory corrupt hota hai. Re-flash se board badle bina theek ho sakta hai.

faqs.question: Picture theek hai par sound nahi aa raha. Kya problem ho sakti hai?
faqs.answer: Settings, kharab speaker, dhila connector ya kharab audio amplifier IC. Technician pehle external speaker laga kar check karta hai.

faqs.question: Mujhe kya warranty milegi?
faqs.answer: Repair kiye gaye board aur lagaye gaye parts par TiptoBook repair warranty milti hai.

faqs.question: Kya mere TV par bijli giri ya voltage surge hua?
faqs.answer: Surge se kai boards kharab ho sakte hain. Quote sirf inspection ke baad diya jaata hai; hum stabiliser ya surge protector lagane ki salah bhi dete hain.

geyser-checkup-descaling.name: Geyser Check-up aur Descaling
geyser-checkup-descaling.shortDescription: Technician ghar aakar pata karega ki geyser garam kyun nahi ho raha ya trip kyun ho raha hai, aur andar jama scale saaf karega taaki paani jaldi garam ho.
geyser-checkup-descaling.fullDescription: Patna ke hard water se geyser ke tank ke andar aur heating element par safed scale jam jaata hai. faqs.question: Geyser ki service kitni baar karwani chahiye?
faqs.answer: Saal mein ek baar, behtar hai sardi se pehle (October–November). Hard water wale area mein scale jaldi jamta hai, isliye har saal descaling se paani jaldi garam hota hai aur bijli kam lagti hai.

faqs.question: Agar repair karwa loon to kya check-up fee alag se lagegi?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Agar aap repair approve karte hain to check-up fee final repair bill mein adjust ho jaati hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap gas geyser ki service karte hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Abhi hum sirf electric storage aur instant geyser par kaam karte hain.

faqs.question: Kya service ke dauraan geyser use nahi kar paayenge?
faqs.answer: Haan, lagbhag ek ghante tak. Tank ka paani nikaalne aur safai ke samay geyser ki bijli aur paani ki supply band rahti hai.

faqs.question: Mera geyser brand warranty mein hai. Kya booking karun?
faqs.answer: Pehle brand se pata kar lijiye. Jaise Racold element aur tank par kai saal ka cover deta hai. Hamari service se andar ke parts ke liye brand warranty claim par asar pad sakta hai.

geyser-element-thermostat-replacement.name: Heating Element aur Thermostat Replacement
geyser-element-thermostat-replacement.shortDescription: Geyser garam nahi kar raha, zyada garam ho raha hai, ya power trip ho rahi hai? Hum kharab element ya thermostat test karke replace karte hain.

Neeche diye labour charge mein part nikalna, naya gasket lagana, paani wapas bharna aur heating test shamil hai. Parts ka bill listed rate par banega. Jahan available ho, wahan local aur branded dono option milte hain.

faqs.question: Kaise pata chalega ki element kharab hai ya thermostat?
faqs.answer: Garam nahi ho raha aur MCB trip ho raha hai, to aksar element kharab hota hai. Paani bahut garam ya bahut thanda ho, ya light jal rahi ho par heating na ho, to aksar thermostat kharab hota hai. Technician meter test se confirm karta hai.

faqs.question: Kya parts original brand ke hote hain?
faqs.answer: Aap chunein. Hum local-compatible parts dete hain, aur jahan available ho wahan branded parts bhi. Dono ke price lagane se pehle dikhaye jate hain.

faqs.question: Mera geyser 8–10 saal purana hai. Repair karayein ya naya lein?
faqs.answer: Agar tank leak ho raha hai ya usmein jung lag gaya hai, to naya lein. Agar sirf element ya thermostat kharab hai aur tank theek hai, to repair aksar sasta padta hai.

faqs.question: Kya mere geyser ki brand warranty abhi bhi valid hai?
faqs.answer: Kai brands element par kai saal ki warranty dete hain. Pehle apna warranty card check karein, ho sakta hai brand free mein replace kar de.

geyser-installation-uninstallation.name: Geyser Installation aur Uninstallation
geyser-installation-uninstallation.shortDescription: Naye instant ya storage geyser ki wall-mounting aur plumbing connection, saath hi purane geyser ko safely nikalna.
geyser-installation-uninstallation.fullDescription: Naya geyser liya hai ya ghar shift kar rahe hain? Hamara technician mazboot deewar mein drill karke geyser lagata hai, inlet aur outlet pipe jodta hai, safety ya pressure valve fit karta hai, power ko earthed socket se jodta hai, tank bharta hai, aur heating aur leak test karta hai. Storage geyser (10–25 L) bhaari hote hain aur chhote instant geyser (1–6 L) se zyada mazboot fitting chahiye hoti hai. Geyser nikalne ke liye hum power aur paani band karte hain, tank khaali karte hain, geyser alag karte hain aur pipe ko cap karte hain. Agar pipe, valve aur wiring lagani pade to uska charge alag se lagega.

faqs.question: Kya brand free mein install karta hai?
faqs.answer: Kuch brand naye geyser ke saath free installation dete hain. Apna invoice check karein. Agar nahi milta, ya aapko jaldi chahiye, to hamein book karein.

faqs.question: Kya mujhe pipe aur valve khareedne honge?
faqs.answer: Naye geyser ke saath aam taur par bracket aur safety valve aata hai. Pipe aksar alag se lagte hain. Technician aakar bata dega aur sirf jo use hoga uska hi charge lagega.

faqs.question: Instant ya storage — kis mein zyada kaam hai?
faqs.answer: Storage geyser paani bharne par bhaari ho jaate hain, isliye mazboot deewar aur achhi anchoring chahiye. Instant geyser chhote hote hain aur jaldi lag jaate hain.

faqs.question: Kaun sa power point chahiye?
faqs.answer: Storage geyser ke liye alag se 15/16 A earthed socket chahiye. Instant geyser (3 kW) ke liye bhi 15/16 A point chahiye. Is service mein hum nayi wiring nahi karte.

faqs.question: Kya khokhli ya kamzor deewar par laga sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Safety ke liye storage geyser sirf mazboot eent ya concrete ki deewar par hi lagta hai.

geyser-leakage-valve-repair.name: Tank Leakage aur Valve Repair
geyser-leakage-valve-repair.shortDescription: Geyser se paani tapak raha hai? Hum leak ho rahe valve, pipe aur gasket theek karte hain, aur check karte hain ki tank kharab to nahi hai.
geyser-leakage-valve-repair.fullDescription: Tapakta geyser paani barbaad karta hai aur chalu wiring ke paas hone se khatarnak bhi ho sakta hai. Zyada tar leak ghise hue safety ya pressure valve, dheele inlet/outlet pipe, ya element flange ke aas-paas purane gasket se hote hain. Hamara technician pehle power band karta hai, leak kahan se hai pata karta hai, aur ghisa hua part badal deta hai. Agar andar ka tank hi crack ho gaya hai ya jung se gal gaya hai, to hum aapko saaf-saaf batate hain: tank badalne ka kharcha naye geyser ke daam ka bada hissa hota hai, aur poora geyser badalna zyada samajhdari ho sakti hai. Valve se lagatar tapakne ka matlab paani ka pressure zyada hona bhi ho sakta hai, jise hum check karte hain.

faqs.question: Geyser garam hote waqt chhote valve se paani tapakta hai. Kya yeh normal hai?
faqs.answer: Garam hote waqt kuch boondein tapakna normal ho sakta hai; valve pressure nikalta hai. Agar lagatar paani behta hai ya geyser band hone par bhi tapakta hai, to valve badalna padega.

faqs.question: Kya leak ho rahe tank ko weld kiya ja sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Hum tank weld nahi karte; pressure wale heater ke liye yeh safe nahi hai. Hum tank badalte hain ya naya geyser lene ki salah dete hain.

faqs.question: Kya leak hota geyser khatarnak hai?
faqs.answer: Ho sakta hai agar paani wiring tak pahunch jaye. Technician ke aane tak geyser ko MCB ya socket se band kar dein aur inlet valve band rakhein.

faqs.question: Kya tank badalwana sahi rahega?
faqs.answer: Kharcha compare karein. Naya tank aur labour milakar ek chhote naye geyser ke daam ke kareeb pahunch sakta hai. Kai brand 5–7 saal ki tank warranty dete hain, isliye pehle woh check kar lein.

new-home-construction.name: Naya Ghar Construction
new-home-construction.shortDescription: Patna mein apna ghar banwaiye: fixed per-sq-ft rate, saaf materials list aur stage-wise payment ke saath.
new-home-construction.fullDescription: Patna aur aas-paas ke towns mein naya ghar banwane ke liye hum aapko ek verified civil contractor team se jodte hain. Site visit ke baad aapko per-sq-ft quote milta hai. Ye quote aapke plot, mitti aur aapke chune hue finish level (basic, standard ya premium) par depend karta hai. Quote mein cement, steel, eent, tile aur fitting ke brands likhe hote hain. Payment stage ke hisaab se hota hai, jaise foundation, slab aur finishing, isliye aap sirf utne kaam ka paisa dete hain jitna ho chuka hai. Drawings, approvals aur boundary wall alag se add karwa sakte hain.

faqs.question: Kya per-sq-ft rate final hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Ye sirf shuruaati estimate hai. Final rate site visit, mitti ki jaanch aur aapke chune hue materials ke baad fix hota hai, aur agreement mein likha jaata hai.

faqs.question: Aap kaun se areas cover karte hain?
faqs.answer: Patna city aur aas-paas ke areas jaise Danapur, Phulwari, Bihta aur Naubatpur. Bihar ke dusre towns request par.

faqs.question: Payment kaise hota hai?
faqs.answer: Kaam ke hisaab se stages mein, jaise foundation, plinth, har slab, brickwork aur finishing. Razorpay se online ya bank transfer se payment kar sakte hain.

faqs.question: Foundation ka kharcha zyada kyun ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Patna ke kuch plots mein nadi kinare wali naram mitti hoti hai. Inmein gehri footing ya piling lag sakti hai, jiska quote soil test ke baad alag se diya jaata hai.

faqs.question: 1,000 sq ft ka ghar banne mein kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par kai mahine, floors, mausam aur labour par depend karta hai; tyohaar aur fasal katai ke season mein kaam dheema ho sakta hai. Aapka contractor stage-wise timeline share karta hai.

faqs.question: 1,500 sq ft ka standard ghar kitne mein banta hai?
faqs.answer: Public 2026 estimates ke hisaab se Patna mein standard finish par lagbhag ₹27–32 lakh. Aapka quote design aur mitti par depend karega.

interior-design.name: Interior Design
interior-design.shortDescription: Patna mein 1BHK se 3BHK flat ke liye pura home interior: kitchen, wardrobe, ceiling, lights aur paint.
interior-design.fullDescription: Designer aapke flat ya ghar par visit karte hain, har room ka measurement lete hain aur aapke rehne ke tareeke aur budget par baat karte hain. Aapko 2D layout, main rooms ke 3D views aur itemised quote milta hai jismein board, laminate aur hardware ke brands likhe hote hain. Kaam mein aam taur par modular kitchen, wardrobe, TV unit, false ceiling, lighting aur painting shamil hote hain. Production shuru hone se pehle har design aap approve karte hain. Payment booking, production aur handover stages mein baanta jaata hai. Sirf ek room ya sirf kitchen ka kaam bhi ho sakta hai.

faqs.question: Kya design consultation free hai?
faqs.answer: Pehla home visit aur rough estimate free hai. Detailed 3D designs ke liye thoda booking amount lag sakta hai, jo final bill mein adjust ho jaata hai.

faqs.question: Kya main sirf ek room ya kitchen ka kaam karwa sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Haan. Sirf kitchen, sirf bedroom ya sirf wardrobe ke kaam ka quote alag se diya jaata hai.

faqs.question: Kaun se materials use hote hain?
faqs.answer: Quote mein board type (jaise BWP/MR ply), laminate aur hinge/channel ke brand likhe hote hain taaki aap compare kar sakein. Upgrade ka price har item ke hisaab se lagta hai.

faqs.question: 2BHK mein kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Design approval ke baad aam taur par kuch hafte, kaam ke scope aur factory lead time par depend karta hai. Aapke designer schedule share karte hain.

faqs.question: Payment kaise karna hai?
faqs.answer: Stages mein: booking, production shuru hone par aur handover par. Razorpay se online ya bank transfer se pay karein.

design-planning-2d-3d.name: 2D/3D Design aur Planning
design-planning-2d-3d.shortDescription: Aapke ghar ke liye Vastu ke hisaab se floor plan, 3D front elevation aur working drawings, online milenge.
design-planning-2d-3d.fullDescription: Aap apne plot ka size, direction aur kitne kamre chahiye ye bata dijiye. Hamare partner architect furniture layout ke saath 2D floor plan banayenge. 3D front elevation bhi le sakte hain, jisse dikh jayega ki ghar kaisa dikhega. Saath mein working, structural aur electrical-plumbing drawings bhi milti hain, jinse aapka contractor ghar bana sakta hai. Aap chahein to plan Vastu ke hisaab se banega. Chhote-mote changes price mein shamil hain. Files PDF mein bheji jati hain. Patna aur aas-paas ke plot ke liye site visit bhi add kar sakte hain.

faqs.question: Aapko mujhse kya-kya chahiye?
faqs.answer: Plot ki lambai aur chaudai, road kis side hai aur direction kya hai, kitne floor banenge, aur aapko kaun-kaun se kamre chahiye. Plot ka rough sketch ya photo ho to aur madad milegi.

faqs.question: Kya plan Vastu ke hisaab se hoga?
faqs.answer: Agar aap bolenge to kamre aam Vastu niyamon ke hisaab se rakhe jayenge. Aapke liye kya zaroori hai wo bata dijiye, jaise kitchen ya pooja room kis direction mein ho.

faqs.question: Main kitne changes karwa sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Chhote revisions shamil hain (aam taur par 3 tak). Approval ke baad layout mein bade changes ka alag charge lagega.

faqs.question: Kya is plan ko nagar nigam se approval milega?
faqs.answer: Drawings standard setback ke hisaab se banti hain, lekin sanction Patna Municipal Corporation/authority ke rules par depend karta hai. Approval ki fees aur approval ka kaam alag hai.

faqs.question: Kya mera contractor isse ghar bana sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Sirf floor plan layout samajhne ke liye hota hai. Ghar banane ke liye poora set lijiye, jismein working, structural aur electrical/plumbing drawings hon.

false-ceiling-lighting.name: False Ceiling aur Lighting
false-ceiling-lighting.shortDescription: Gypsum, POP ya PVC false ceiling, cove aur panel lights ke saath. Price per square foot ke hisaab se lagta hai.
false-ceiling-lighting.fullDescription: Technician aapke ghar aakar room ka naap lete hain, ceiling ki height check karte hain aur aapke saath design aur lights ki baat karte hain. Smooth aur jaldi finish ke liye gypsum board chun sakte hain, detailed shapes ke liye POP, aur bathroom, balcony ya seelan wali jagah ke liye PVC panels. Price mein frame, boards, joint finishing aur primer shaamil hain, saath mein lights ke cut-outs bhi. LED panels, cove strips aur unki wiring ka quote per point diya jaata hai. Zyada tar ek room ka kaam kuch dino mein pura ho jaata hai, aur kaam ke baad malba saaf kar diya jaata hai.

faqs.answer: Ceiling ke area ko square feet mein naapa jaata hai. Cove design aur drops ke liye running-foot ka extra charge lag sakta hai, jo quote mein likha hota hai.

faqs.question: Gypsum ya POP: kaun sa better hai?
faqs.answer: Gypsum jaldi lagta hai, zyada smooth hota hai aur gandagi kam hoti hai. POP curved ya detailed design ke liye sahi hai, lekin isko set aur finish hone mein zyada time lagta hai.

faqs.question: Kya bathroom mein false ceiling laga sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Bathroom aur balcony ke liye PVC panels better hain kyunki un par nami ka asar nahi hota. Wahan gypsum lagana ho to moisture-resistant board chahiye.

faqs.question: Kya lights price mein shaamil hain?
faqs.answer: Price mein lights ke cut-outs shaamil hain. Fittings aur wiring points ka charge alag lagta hai, taaki aap apni pasand ka brand chun sakein.

faqs.question: Kya painting shaamil hai?
faqs.answer: Primer shaamil hai. Final paint coat ka quote alag diya jaata hai, jab tak aapke package mein kuch aur na likha ho.

faqs.question: Kya isse room ki height kam ho jaayegi?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par kuch inch kam hoti hai, design ke hisaab se. Visit ke time technician aapki ceiling ki height check karte hain.

renovation-remodeling.name: Renovation & Remodeling
renovation-remodeling.shortDescription: Patna mein bathroom, kitchen ya poore ghar ka renovation, site visit ke baad item-wise quote ke saath.
renovation-remodeling.fullDescription: Ek supervisor aapke ghar aata hai, deewar, plumbing, waterproofing aur wiring check karta hai, aur aap kya badalna chahte hain wo note karta hai. Aapko item-wise quote milta hai jismein todna-phodna (demolition), civil kaam, tiling, fittings aur malba hatana sab shaamil hota hai. 10–15 saal se purane gharon mein bathroom ko aksar naya waterproofing aur nayi pipeline chahiye hoti hai, isliye ye sabse pehle check kiye jaate hain. Kitchen ko naye tiles, granite aur sink se naya look diya ja sakta hai, ya modular units ke saath poora remodel kiya ja sakta hai. Poore ghar ke kaam mein painting, flooring, ceiling aur electrical upgrade ek saath liye ja sakte hain.

faqs.question: Kya mujhe ghar khaali karna padega?
faqs.answer: Sirf ek bathroom ya kitchen ke kaam ke liye nahi. Poore ghar ke renovation mein kuch time ke liye kahin aur rehna aksar aasaan hota hai.

faqs.question: Purane bathroom mein kharcha zyada kyun hota hai?
faqs.answer: 10–15 saal se purane gharon mein aksar naya waterproofing aur nayi plumbing lines chahiye hoti hain, jisse labour aur material ka kharcha badh jaata hai.

faqs.question: Kya main apne tiles aur fittings khud de sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Haan. Tab quote mein sirf labour aur civil material shaamil hota hai, aur brand aur price aap khud decide karte hain.

faqs.question: Kya warranty milti hai?
faqs.answer: Kaarigari (workmanship) aur waterproofing cover ki sharten aapke quote mein likhi hoti hain.

faqs.question: Final price kaise tay hota hai?
faqs.answer: Site visit ke baad aapko item-wise quote milta hai. Demolition ke time agar extra kaam nikalta hai, to wo aapko dikhaya jaata hai aur aapki approval ke baad hi kiya jaata hai.

full-home-painting.name: Poore Ghar ki Painting
full-home-painting.shortDescription: Patna mein aapke poore flat ya ghar ka repaint ya fresh paint, site measurement ke baad area ke hisaab se price.
full-home-painting.fullDescription: Hamari painting team visit karti hai, deewaron aur ceiling ka measurement leti hai, seelan (damp) aur crack check karti hai, aur per square foot ka likhit quote deti hai. Paint grade aap chunte hain: Asian Paints, Berger, Nerolac ya Birla Opus ka economy, premium ya luxury emulsion. Price mein furniture covering, halki sanding, crack filling, primer ka 1 coat aur 2 top coat shaamil hain. Naye ghar mein wall putty ke 2 coat bhi lagte hain. Bahar ki deewaron (exterior) ka quote alag diya jaata hai, kyunki unmein weather-grade paint aur kabhi-kabhi scaffolding lagti hai. Zyadatar 2 BHK interior 4–6 working din mein poore ho jaate hain.

faqs.question: Price kaise calculate karte hain?
faqs.answer: Jin deewaron aur ceiling ko paint karna hai, un sabka measurement lete hain, bade darwaze aur khidki ghata kar, aur aapke paint grade ke per-sq-ft rate se guna karte hain. Kaam shuru hone se pehle aapko breakup likhit mein milta hai.

faqs.question: Kya inspection visit free hai?
faqs.answer: Patna city limits ke andar visit free hai. Bahar ke liye thoda travel charge lagta hai, jo booking karne par final bill mein adjust ho jaata hai.

faqs.question: Kya paint main khud khareed sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Haan, hum kam rate par sirf labour wala kaam kar sakte hain. Tab shade mismatch ya paint kam padne ki zimmedari aapki hogi, isliye hamari salah hai ki paint hum hi laayein.

faqs.question: 2 BHK mein kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Interior ke liye aam taur par 4–6 working din, deewar ki halat, putty ke kaam aur coats ke beech sukhne ke time par depend karta hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap seelan wali deewar theek karte hain?
faqs.answer: Seelan ke upar paint karne se paint phir se utar jaata hai. Hum visit ke time seepage bata dete hain aur painting se pehle waterproofing ka quote alag dete hain.

faqs.question: Kya kamre khaali karne honge?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Hum halka furniture beech mein karke cover kar dete hain. Kripya toot-ne wala saamaan aur deewar par tange items pehle se pack kar lein.

interior-wall-painting.name: Room-by-Room Painting
interior-wall-painting.shortDescription: Sirf ek wall, ek room ya kuch rooms paint karwayein, texture ya accent wall bhi, fixed starting price par.
interior-wall-painting.fullDescription: Har ghar ko poora repaint ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Aap sirf ek wall, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom ya balcony ke liye booking kar sakte hain. Painter aapke furniture ko cover karta hai, dheela paint scrape karta hai, chhote cracks bharta hai, primer lagata hai aur aapke chune hue shade mein 2 coat karta hai. Alag look ke liye bold colour mein accent wall ya rustic, sand ya stencil design jaisa texture finish chun sakte hain. Chhote kaam ek din mein ho jaate hain; poora room aam taur par 2 din leta hai kyunki har coat ko sukhne ka time chahiye. Agar wall badi hai ya kharab hai to final price site par confirm hota hai.

faqs.question: Agar mera room package se bada hai to?
faqs.answer: Painter kaam shuru karne se pehle naap leta hai. Extra area ka charge usi per-sq-ft rate par lagta hai, aur kaam shuru hone se pehle aap naya total approve karte hain.

faqs.question: Kya aap meri purani wall ka colour match kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, agar aap shade ka naam ya code bata dein. Warna hum shade cards se aankh se match karte hain; purane, fade hue paint ka bilkul exact match guarantee nahi hai.

faqs.question: Room kitne time baad use kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Emulsion kuch ghante mein chhoone layak sukh jata hai. Ek din tak furniture wall se door rakhein aur lagbhag 2 hafte tak wall na dhoyein.

faqs.question: Kaun se texture chun sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Aam options hain rustic, sand, stucco-look, combing aur stencil patterns. Painter sample catalogue laata hai; complex designer finish ka kharcha zyada hota hai.

faqs.question: Kya smell aati hai?
faqs.answer: Hum default mein kam smell wale water-based emulsion use karte hain. Khidkiyan khuli rakhein; zyadatar log agli raat usi room mein so jaate hain.
